login.title: Log in
login.name: Name
login.noAccount: No account? Ask a member for an invite link.

calendar.howToBody: Click a day to mark yourself free all day (outlined). For only the morning, afternoon or evening, hold the day on a phone or double-click (or right-click) it on a computer. Do it again to add a second free time that day, e.g. morning and evening. Initials show who is free (<sup>am</sup> / <sup>pm</sup> / <sup>eve</sup> for part of the day); green means everyone shown is free at the same time.
calendar.howToGroups: You see the free time and events of people who share a group with you, and of public accounts; pick one group above the calendar to see only theirs.
calendar.dayFree: Click: I am free all day

event.hint: Leave the end date empty for a one-day event.
event.title: Title

shareWith.public: Public: everyone who sees your free time (all your groups)
shareWith.private: Private: only the groups you pick
shareWith.noGroups: Not in any group yet: there is nobody to share it with privately.

newPoll.title: New poll
newPoll.deadlineHint: The last day to answer: the poll closes after it.

poll.private: Private: only the groups it is shared with
poll.suggested: The dashed answers come from your free days: check them, then save.
poll.tied: Tied on yes and no — pick the one you want.
poll.addedAs: Added to the calendar as {{title}} on {{date}}.
poll.deadlineHint: The last day to answer. Empty: no deadline.

groups.title: Groups
groups.intro: Members of a group see each other's free time and events on the calendar, even with a private account.
groups.feedHint: This group's events only. For how to subscribe go to Settings
groups.confirmDelete: Delete the group {{name}} for everyone in it?
groups.none: You are not in any group yet. Create one, or ask someone to invite you.

settings.title: Settings
settings.continuous: Continuous calendar: fill the first and last weeks with the days of the months around
settings.hideOwnInitials: Hide my own initials on the calendar
settings.integrationHint: Update every hour, Manual days have priority
settings.ignoreHint: Comma-separated. Does nothing for Outlook "Availability only" links
settings.countFreeLong: Count events shown as Free (otherwise only Busy events count)
settings.whereGoogle: Google Calendar (web): Settings → your calendar under "Settings for my calendars" → Integrate calendar → Secret address in iCal format.
settings.whereOutlook: Outlook (web): Settings → Calendar → Shared calendars → Publish a calendar → ICS link.
settings.whereApple: Apple iCloud: Calendar → share icon next to the calendar → Public Calendar → copy the link.
settings.feedsHint: Private link: anyone who has it can read it. Rotating it requires re-subscribing.
settings.groupFeedsHint: Group events: each group you are in gets its own feed here.
settings.subscribeGoogle: Google Calendar (web): Other calendars → + → From URL → paste the https link. Google refreshes every 12–24 h and cannot be forced.
settings.subscribeApple: Apple Calendar: click the webcal link, or File → New Calendar Subscription. Choose a short auto-refresh interval.
settings.subscribeOutlook: Outlook (web): Add calendar → Subscribe from web → paste the https link. Refreshes every few hours.
settings.inviteHint: A link to create an account: valid 7 days, single use. Send it only to who you mean to invite.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.privateHint: In private mode, only group members can see your free time slots and events.
profile.passkeysHint: Log in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of typing a password. Your password keeps working.
profile.cannotExport: This browser cannot export the passkey. Try another one.

admin.title: Administration
admin.membersHint: A member who forgot their password needs a reset link — send them the one you create here.
admin.confirmRemove: Remove {{name}}? Their events and polls are deleted.
admin.groupsOn: Turn groups on? Groups come back, and every private member, event and poll is private again.
admin.groupsOff: Turn groups off? Every member, event and poll is shown to everyone until groups are back on.
admin.groupsHint: Turning groups off shows every member, event and poll to everyone, and hides groups and every public / private choice. Nothing is deleted: turning them back on brings back the groups and each private / public choice.
admin.memberInvites: Members can create invite links (in their Settings)
admin.memberInvitesHint: Turning it off also cancels the links members made that nobody has used yet.

notices.rotated: Feed links rotated. Re-subscribe in your calendar apps.
notices.invite_copied: Link created and copied: paste it to them.
notices.removed: Member removed. Their sessions, passkeys and feed links no longer work.
notices.invited: Invite sent. They join once they accept it.
notices.calendar_added: Calendar connected. Your free days are filled in from it.
notices.calendar_rules: Rules saved. Your free days are worked out again with them.

errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.passkeyUnverified: That passkey could not be verified.
errors.inviteGone: This link is invalid, used, or expired.
errors.passwordShort: Password must be at least {{min}} characters.
errors.newPasswordShort: New password must be at least {{min}} characters.
errors.tooManySlots: You can be free at most {{max}} times in a day. Take one off first.

privateNeedsGroup.event: A private event needs at least one group to share it with.
privateNeedsGroup.poll: A private poll needs at least one group to share it with.

errors.pickStartTime: Pick a start time, or tick All day.
errors.eventForbidden: Only its creator or an admin can change this event.

errors.pollForbidden: Only its creator or an admin can change who sees this poll.
errors.notBestDate: Not one of the best dates.
errors.notInGroup: You are not in this group.

errors.typeInvitee: Type the name of who to invite.
errors.adminsOnlyAdd: Only admins can add members directly.
errors.inviteNotWaiting: That invite is no longer waiting.
errors.useLeave: Use Leave to leave the group yourself.
errors.memberInvitesOff: An admin has turned off invite links for members.
errors.calendarLink: Paste an https:// or webcal:// link.
errors.calendarForbidden: Only its owner or an admin can change this calendar.
errors.pollDeadline: The deadline must be a date from today on.
errors.syncDays: Invalid number of days to fill.
errors.weekStart: Invalid first day of the week.
errors.birthdayFuture: Your birthday cannot be in the future.

event.startDate: A valid start date is required.
event.endDate: The end date must be on or after the start date.
event.endNeedsStart: An end time needs a start time.
event.multiDayEnd: A timed event over several days needs an end time.
event.endAfterStart: The end time must be after the start time.

sync.httpStatus: The calendar answered {{status}}. Check that the link is the secret iCal address.
sync.tooBig: That calendar is too big (over 5 MB).
sync.notIcal: That link is not an iCal calendar.
